why: Intro to Git plan, 'See what changed with log and diff' (passes: git log shows three commits and git status reports a clean working tree). To look at the old recipe the learner ran `git checkout 1a2b3c4`, which left them on a detached HEAD, and committed there: '[detached HEAD 7e8f9a0] Double the sugar'. main still has two commits, the new one belongs to no branch (lost on the next switch), git log shows two commits and git status says 'HEAD detached from 1a2b3c4' above 'nothing to commit, working tree clean'.

step.title: Commit the second change
step.instructions: Change the sugar in pancakes.md to 2 tbsp and commit it with git commit -am "Double the sugar". git log --oneline should now list three commits, and git status a clean tree.

files.cookbook/pancakes.md:
# Pancakes

- 1 cup flour
- 1 egg
- 1 cup milk
- 2 tbsp sugar

Terminal: 5e6f7a8 (HEAD -> main) Add a pinch of salt
You are in 'detached HEAD' state. You can look around, make experimental
changes and commit them, and you can discard any commits you make in this
state without impacting any branches by switching back to a branch.
HEAD is now at 1a2b3c4 Add pancakes
tripi@mac cookbook % git commit -am "Double the sugar"
nothing to commit, working tree clean
